title: Well-paid departments
statementMd:
List departments whose average salary is **above 110,000**. Show the department name and the average salary rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `department`, `avg_salary`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.name AS department, ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) AS avg_salary
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id
GROUP BY d.id, d.name
HAVING AVG(e.salary) > 110000;
```

Join to get names, group per department, and filter groups on the unrounded average.
